verdicts.reason: A has a broken reading order: the 'Find a Store' CTA sits at the very top before any message, the bottle shrinks to a tiny icon that no longer works as the hero, and SOLSTICE is blown up to near-headline size below the headline, so they compete as focal points. B uses a sensible split with the bottle large on the left and the CTA last, but SOLSTICE is still oversized and placed under the headline instead of above it, 'fizz' is orphaned on its own line, the body copy is small and cramped on the green circle, and the text column is jammed toward the right edge.
